test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement(s) is correct about MNCs?

**Statements:**

(1) A MNC is a company that owns or controls production in more than one nation.

(2) They lead to creation of monopoly in the home country.

(3) They are also called stateless organisations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statements 1 and 3.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A multinational corporation( MNC) is a company that operates in its home country, as well as in other countries around the world.
 
• It maintains a central office located in one country, which coordinates the operation of all its other services, similar to executive branches or manufactories.** Hence, Statement 1 is correct.**
 
• It isn’t enough to call a company that exports its products to further than one country a transnational company.
 
• They need to maintain factual business operations in other countries and must make a foreign direct investment there.
 
• In each country, the business may oversee multiple offices that function through several branches and subsidiaries. So, it is called stateless organizations. **Hence, Statement 3 is correct.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Foreign Direct Investment:**

 
 
• 
 
Foreign direct investments are current within transnational pots. Investments do when an investor or company from one country makes an investment outside the country of operation. Foreign investments most frequently do when a foreign business is established or bought outright. It can be distinguished from the purchase of a transnational portfolio that only contains equities of the company, rather than copping more direct control.
